Forget expensive stain removers... 🍋 Lynsey Crombie reveals the quick hack she uses to tackle lipstick marks on clothes.

Today’s @thismorning Stain Masterclass was so much fun! 🧺✨

We covered some of the most common summer stains and, more importantly, how to get rid of them!

🖊️ Felt tip pen – try rubbing alcohol or hand sanitiser.

🤎 Fake tan – pre-treat with a bio liquid laundry detergent or white vinegar.

🌱 Grass stains – white toothpaste can work wonders.

☀️ Sun cream stains – rinse with ice-cold water, then treat with white vinegar.

…and many more handy stain-busting tips!

Great catch up with @julietsear too 

If you missed it live, you can catch up anytime on the This Morning app. Let me know in the comments which stain you struggle with the most

#summerstains #stainclinic #queenofclean

Please don’t skip your skin checks. 💛

Nearly three years ago, I was diagnosed with melanoma, and today was another one of my regular skin check appointments.

I still get anxious before every visit because you never know what they might find, but I’d rather have that worry than ignore something that could be serious.

Thankfully, today’s check was all clear. They did freeze one mole that had been rubbing on my clothes, but everything else looked good.

If my journey has taught me anything, it’s this: wear your SPF, get to know your skin, and never ignore a changing mole. Early detection really can save lives.

Have you checked your skin recently? 💛☀️

#melanomaawareness #skincancer
